shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~81 files, ~25,500 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Workshop item **3776015553** (public). See §31.

**⚠ THE VERIFICATION TABLE WAS RE-BASED 2026-08-01.** The user tested the 190/254 tiers, all 15 utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router **outside Modmixer**. §9's run log records agent-driven runs ONLY.

**⚠⚠ THE §33 SESSION COST FIVE RUNS AND PRODUCED THREE LESSONS WORTH MORE THAN THE FEATURE. Read §33c and §33f before touching drafted movement.**

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** **✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED (#294)** - 50.0% of door writes, 14.3% of pawn checks skipped.
**✅ §33b SINGLE-PAWN CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS VERIFIED (#295, re-confirmed #300).**
**🔧 §33f GROUP CROSS-LEVEL ORDERS: ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED (#300), UNVERIFIED.** `Normalise` was pulling group drag endpoints onto the pawns' band unconditionally. **This also explains the "missing ghost".**
**⛔ §33c ENTRY ANIMATION REVERTED** after breaking movement. Pop-out only; `ReadyToCarry` BUILT, NOT WIRED.
**🔧 §33a PATH LINE: four defects found and fixed, UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §33g `FindPathNow` MOVED OFF THE RENDER LOOP** - a hazard I introduced, now built on the tick. UNVERIFIED.
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a BUILT, UNVERIFIED.** **🔧 §32a NEVER FIRED** (needs a raid). **🔧 §32c slider OFF, unexercised.**
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS** - every power/pipe system builds from raw CELL ADJACENCY (§30).
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION** - `AB_OpenAir` declares no affordances.
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS ALSO UNPATHABLE, INCLUDING FOR FLYING PAWNS.** `AB_OpenAir` is `Impassable` and does NOT set `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, the only exemption `PathGrid.CalculatedCostAt` honours for `PathGridDef Flying`. §32 depends on this.
**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES - ONE DECISION IN THREE COSTUMES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow` descends; the see-through click rule only subtracts; the combat renderer only draws down. **§33b/§33f are the worked examples of the fix** for the still-open combat case (§13 item 2).
**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`). Anchoring 190 *determined* the rest.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** **⚠ 318 blocked by arithmetic; 62 deliberately absent.** **⚠ The wide gutter was real safety and is gone.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET'S STATED JUSTIFICATION WAS PARTLY WRONG - THE BUDGET ITSELF IS NOT.** See §32.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease.
**⚠⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS EXIST - THE PER-TICK SWEEP AND `PatherArrived` - AND NOTHING MAY GATE EITHER** (§33c). They must agree on the same OUTCOME; that is not a licence to add a new precondition to both.
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug.
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
`ABDepthView` is the ONE definition. **⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK: `CanShrink` IS AN ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`** (Item, Plant, Filth). **Pawns take the realtime path and DO shrink.**
**⚠ THE REASON IS THAT TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** A shrunken building no longer fits its footprint and reads as *wrong size*, not distance. HARD rule.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX CARRIES TWO EFFECTS AND THEY MULTIPLY IN ONE POSTFIX.** Do not add a second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**
**⚠ AGENT-DRIVEN RUNS ONLY.** OLD: #255 5x190 Boreal **~4.1 s** (best). NEW (all 5x126): #278 **~1.6 s** | #277 +Caves +River ~3.4 s | **#294-#300 Mountainous ExtremeDesert ~3.1 s** (carve 1,998 ms, **1,575 of it `FillRock band 0`**).
**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST.**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size.** **⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** (21x spread). **⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED** (n=2 was not a pattern). **⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.**
**⚠ `Pathing.RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER.**
**9g.** 1. **Basement rock suppression**. 2. `GenStep_Plants` (demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=22.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE / BISECT / RISER / PATHING / BAND-INFO lines arrive as `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US.** **Info is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE.** #297-#300 logged nothing but the generation profile while cross-level group movement was completely broken. The bridge sees THROWN EXCEPTIONS; a patch that returns the wrong bool is silent. **Never report "clean run" as if it were evidence.** What it does prove, free on every launch: no `Skipped patch class` warning means every `[HarmonyPatch]` resolved its target.
**⚠⚠ ASK FOR THE EXISTING DIAGNOSTIC BEFORE THE FIRST GUESS, NOT THE THIRD.** `AB2: band info` and `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` were pinned and unused for four runs while three wrong theories were built and shipped. When they were finally run they solved it in two readings: band info cleared the entire wormhole layer (2 pairs, armed, `CanReach across=True`), and the stuck probe printed `destination (35,0,219)` for a click at `(35,347)` - **exactly one Slot down, which is an arithmetic signature naming the guilty method.**
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ TWO COUNTERS IN DIFFERENT PATCHES THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK** (#294: 433 vs 432).

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the first theory.** A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠⚠ ONE USER GESTURE CAN HAVE TWO CODE PATHS. FIXING ONE LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE FIXING THE FEATURE** (§33f). A drafted "go here" order routes through `FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions` for a SINGLE pawn and through `MultiPawnGotoController` for a GROUP. §33b fixed the single path, was verified working, and the group path kept destroying cross-level orders for five more runs. **When a fix lands in a click handler, enumerate every other handler for the same gesture before declaring it done.**
**⚠⚠ A COSMETIC EFFECT MUST NEVER SIT ON THE CODE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER THE FEATURE HAPPENS** (§33c). The animation hold was bounded, self-cancelling and outlived by the existing timeout - **all true, all beside the point, because the thing it blocked was the loop's own exit condition.**
**⚠⚠ AND WHEN THE REVERT DOES NOT FIX IT, THE HYPOTHESIS WAS WRONG - STOP EXTENDING IT.** Reverting the hold changed nothing, which was proof the diagnosis was wrong, and the next move should have been the pinned diagnostic rather than a fourth theory.
**⚠ WHEN A CORE FEATURE REGRESSES, REVERT FIRST AND DIAGNOSE AFTER.** Diagnosis is cheap once the user is unblocked and expensive while they are not.
**⚠ A CORRECT PRINCIPLE APPLIED TO THE WRONG THING IS STILL A BUG.** "Both carry triggers must consult the same gate" is right when they decide the SAME OUTCOME; it is not a licence to add a new precondition to both.
**⚠ A GUARD THAT FIRES UNCONDITIONALLY IS NOT THE SAME AS A GUARD THAT FIRES ON ITS TRIGGER** (§33f). `Normalise` existed for drags whose two ends straddle a band boundary - that is what puts the interpolation midpoint in the gutter. It ran on every drag. **Re-read why a guard exists before trusting where it fires.**
**⚠ AN ARITHMETIC SIGNATURE IN A DIAGNOSTIC NAMES THE GUILTY METHOD.** A click at `(35,347)` producing destination `(35,219)` is a difference of exactly one Slot - only band arithmetic does that, and only one method applies it to a drag endpoint.
**⚠ FIXING A HELPER DOES NOT FIX ITS CALL SITES - AUDIT THEM** (§33a). `LocalizeForPawn` was corrected and a line ten rows below in the same file still used the raw operation. **After changing a shared transform, grep for what it replaced.**
**⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO OF THEM RIGHT.** The majority being correct is why the odd one survived.
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE TWO DEFECTS WITH OPPOSITE FIXES - AND THEN A THIRD, AND A FOURTH** (§33a). **Count the defects before writing the patch.**
**⚠ WHEN YOU COPY A LOOP OUT OF ENGINE CODE, COPY ITS DIRECTION TOO.** `Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`: ascending runs FORWARD. **Check against a route that TURNS.**
**⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTH NOTHING IF THE STATE IT READS NEVER CHANGES** (§33c). **Check the range your input can actually take.**
**⚠ REUSING A RADIUS IS REUSING ITS REASONS.** `ArriveRadius` is 3 because a blocked pawn can only get that close. **Two questions, two constants.**
**⚠ AN ASSUMPTION THAT TWO THINGS COINCIDE IS A CLAIM ABOUT A GUARANTEE - GO FIND IT.** Both wormhole ends lift onto the same point for RISERS, NOT for STAIRS.
**⚠ NEVER CALL A SYNCHRONOUS PATHFIND FROM A DRAW CALLBACK** (§33g). `FindPathNow` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`, reaching into the pathfinder mid-frame outside `PathFinderTick`. **Anything expensive or stateful in a draw path belongs on the tick.**
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE HARMONY PATCHED, AND FAILS SILENTLY.** **Corollary: a job holding MANAGED references can never be Burst, so it IS patchable.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE UNVERIFIED CLAIM** (§32).
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING, NOT WHERE THE THING IS** (§33a).
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE** - and **instrumenting three of five early returns is the same mistake as instrumenting none** (§33e: the answer was behind one of the two skipped).
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT** - three times: §33a's job-line localizer, "suppress vanilla and draw our own" (already shipped), and the goto ghost (never deleted).
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE.** **⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** **⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.** **⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.**
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS.** **⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.** **⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ A comment that has gone FALSE is worse than none.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** **Wrap the DATA instead of the reader** (§32). Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature**; **when the offending parameter is a PRIVATE NESTED STRUCT, omit it - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".**
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN** - and **you then own every branch of the original, including the ones you did not notice.**
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED.** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped`.**
**⚠ ORDERING FACTS (§33f).** **A drafted goto has TWO code paths.** ONE pawn: `Selector.HandleMultiselectGoto` / `FloatMenuOptionProvider_DraftedMove` take a `Count == 1` branch straight to `PawnGotoAction` via `RCellFinder.BestOrderedGotoDestNear`. TWO OR MORE: `gotoController.StartInteraction` + `AddPawn`, and `MultiPawnGotoController` owns destinations (`root = start + (end-start) * j/(count-1)`) **and the destination GHOST** (`RenderPawnAt`, skipped on `Fogged` cells). **`active` is set only by `AddPawn`, so with one pawn vanilla draws no ghost at all.**
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS THAT BIT TWICE.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 a humanlike renders from a **cached atlas blit that ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix`** - fix is `disableCache`. **`GetDrawParms` is reached from `ParallelPreDraw`, potentially on WORKER THREADS** - gate dictionary probes behind a plain int count. **`PawnDrawParms.pawn` gives you the pawn.** **A uniform x/z Scale commutes with facing rotation and can be right-multiplied; a TRANSLATION cannot and must be left-multiplied.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`.** **⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.**
**⚠⚠ TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS IN DIFFERENT CELLS.** `isAttachment` takes the cell BESIDE a wall and **needs `supportsWallAttachments`, which ORDINARY WALLS DO NOT HAVE**. `canPlaceOverWall` takes the WALL'S OWN cell - **what players mean**. **`isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE. **`ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` deduped per VARIANT per tick, **`Area`/`AvoidGrid` in the key**. `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` (20 B/cell). `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS; ~10 vanilla JobGivers use it. **`PawnPath` is POOLED.** **`Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`.**
**⚠ `HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `ICollection`.**
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED.** **TWO art families**: Dubwise thick outline; Vanilla/VE almost none.

# 33. CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT

## 33a. THE PATH LINE — FOUR DEFECTS UNDER ONE SYMPTOM
1. **Before the hop it does not exist** - `TrySegment` rewrites the destination before the path is built.
2. **After the hop it is a Slot off screen** - `DrawPath` uses true coordinates; the pawn is drawn lifted.
3. **The preview was REVERSED per leg** - `Peek` ascends FORWARD. **Invisible on a straight corridor.**
4. **The CHAIN START was the one unlifted point**, drawing a vertical line - fixed only after `LocalizeForPawn` itself, because **the broken call site did not use the helper.**
**⚠ VANILLA WAS ALREADY FULLY SUPPRESSED** - any remaining line bug is in OUR replacement.
**⚠ HOP SEGMENTS ARE SKIPPED EXPLICITLY** - both ends coincide for RISERS, not for STAIRS.

## 33b. ✅ SINGLE-PAWN FORCE-MOVE UP — VERIFIED (#295)
`TryTranslateForOrder` rewrote any cross-band click onto the pawns' band. **Fix: the VIEW BAND is the discriminator**, gated on `AnyCanReach`.
**⚠ `Patch_RCellFinder_ABOrderedGotoBand` WAS ALREADY CORRECT.** **⚠ THE ORIGINAL TRANSLATION MUST SURVIVE** - it fixed "three drafted pawns, only one moves".

## 33f. 🔧 GROUPS — THE SAME DEFECT IN THE PATH NOBODY AUDITED (#300)
**Single pawn worked; groups never did.** `Patch_MultiPawnGoto_ABKeepLineInBand.Normalise` pulled BOTH drag endpoints onto the pawns' band **unconditionally**, so a group ordered upward walked to the stairwell's own cell on their current level with no pending transit.
**Fix: normalise only when the two endpoints disagree WITH EACH OTHER.** That is the only case that puts the interpolation midpoint (`j/(count-1)`) in the gutter, which is the sole reason the patch exists. Two endpoints on the viewed band interpolate safely within it.
**⚠ THIS ALSO EXPLAINS THE "MISSING GHOST"** (§33e) - the ghost is a 2+ pawn feature and the group path was broken.
**⚠ THE ARITHMETIC SIGNATURE IS HOW IT WAS FOUND:** click `(35,347)` -> destination `(35,219)`, exactly one Slot.

## 33c. ⛔ THE STAIR ANIMATION — ENTRY HALF REVERTED, POP-OUT ONLY
**Attempt 1 (distance-driven): never played** - `ArriveRadius` 3 vs shrink radius 4 capped progress at 0.25 for one tick.
**Attempt 2 (18-tick hold in both carry triggers): BROKE MOVEMENT.** Gating `TryConsumeArrival` suppresses `PatherArrived`, so the leg never completes and the job re-segments forever.
**Reverted. `ReadyToCarry` kept, UNWIRED, with the analysis attached.**
**⚠⚠ NOTHING COSMETIC MAY SIT ON THE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER A TRANSIT HAPPENS.** The pop-out obeys this - a pure read of "when did the hop occur", recorded after the fact.
**⚠ A THIRD ATTEMPT NEEDS ITS OWN RADIUS** (`AnimateRadius` 1.5) and must be driven from outside the carry decision.

## 33e. THE GOTO GHOST — NOT OURS
Drawn only by `MultiPawnGotoController.Draw` via vanilla's `RenderPawnAt`; **we never deleted it.** `active` is set only by `AddPawn`, so **with one drafted pawn vanilla draws no ghost either.** Now expected to return with §33f. `AB2: goto ghost report` names the cause if not.

## 33g. `FindPathNow` MOVED OFF THE RENDER LOOP
The route preview called a synchronous A* from a draw callback; `FindPathNow` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`, reaching into the pathfinder mid-frame outside `PathFinderTick`, and fired only while a transiting pawn was SELECTED. Now built in `TickRoutes()` on the tick; the draw path reads the cache only.

## 33d. HOW TO VERIFY
**Groups first** - select 2+ drafted pawns, view another level, drag-order onto it. Ghosts should appear and everyone should cross. Then single pawn (regression check). Then the line **on a route that TURNS**. `AB2: band info` before any theory.
